keyconfounds: Conditional native block reduction uses 2KB shared storage instead of original 1KB; original reduction semantics are not certified.
Nine-node/600-row cases and 100 sampled orders do not establish original 45-node runtime or global structure optimality.
Canonical serialized Float32 log-factorials remove compiler-host overload differences; native NVCC-host diagnostic table differs in 73 entries by at most3.05176e-5.
Host C++ FFI, Julia/CUDA reset APIs, dispatch, segmented transfers and host selection all contribute to the measured regions.
JACC.shared initializes512 constant zeros and adds one barrier; KA has an immutable-parent repair prompted by an actual device allocation failure.
All targets reuse pure scalar code and later targets inherit preceding feedback. Actual token windows are marginal ordered activity, not cold-start or billed cost.
No instruction/resource/traffic profiler counters; no bottleneck or roofline inference.
